name: director-obs
description: Provides OBS Studio scene switching and status monitoring.
aiContext:
The OBS extension switches the active OBS Studio video scene.
- obs.switchScene: changes the active scene. sceneName MUST exactly match one of the names in ALL VALID OBS SCENES — never invent scene names.
- Each scene in ALL VALID OBS SCENES carries a 'description' written by the Director operator explaining when the scene is appropriate (e.g. 'single-driver only', 'multi-car wide shot during pace lap', 'use after a driver swap'). You MUST select a scene whose description fits the current race context (number of drivers in the car, session type, on-track situation). If no scene's description fits, prefer NOT switching rather than picking a mismatched scene.
- Always follow obs.switchScene with a system.wait step of at least 1000ms to allow the scene to render before the next action.

intents.title: Switch OBS Scene
intents.description: Changes the active OBS Studio scene. sceneName must exactly match a scene name from ALL VALID OBS SCENES. Pick a scene whose operator-provided description matches the current race context. Always follow with a system.wait step of at least 1000ms.

sceneName.description: Name of the scene to switch to.

intents.title: Get Available Scenes
intents.description: Emits the list of available OBS scenes.

events.title: OBS Connection Changed
events.description: Emitted when OBS connection state changes.
